name: Jennifer Wilde: Unlikely Revolutionaries
source:
At the start of the Jazz Age in Paris in 1921, young French artist Jennifer Chevalier becomes embroiled in death, espionage and revolution which takes her across France, England and Ireland with the ghost of Oscar Wilde. 

A Visual Novel-Point & Click 2D hybrid with a unique comic book inventory design.
translation:
1921年巴黎爵士乐时代伊始，年轻的法国艺术家詹妮弗·舍瓦利埃 (Jennifer Chevalier) 卷入了死亡、间谍活动和革命之中，并与奥斯卡·王尔德 (Oscar Wilde) 的鬼魂一起穿越了法国、英国和爱尔兰。

视觉小说-点击式2D混合游戏，具有独特的漫画书库存设计。
